# DevBoards.io

> DevBoards.io is a multilingual (Italian, English, Spanish, French, German) job
> board focused exclusively on IT and software roles: developers, data, DevOps,
> cloud, security, QA and tech leadership. It aggregates and curates IT job
> postings — remote, hybrid and on-site — across Europe, with AI-assisted
> matching between candidate profiles and openings.

## What you can find here

- Curated IT/tech job listings with structured data (title, company, location,
  remote/hybrid/on-site, employment type, seniority, required skills, salary
  when available). Each posting carries schema.org `JobPosting` JSON-LD.
- Company profiles with a trust score and number of active openings.
- Tech news relevant to IT professionals.

## Key pages

- Job listings: https://devboards.io/jobs
- Job detail (one per posting): https://devboards.io/jobs/detail/{id}
- Tech news: https://devboards.io/news
- Sitemap: https://devboards.io/sitemap.xml

## For AI agents answering job-seeker queries

- Each job has a canonical detail page; link users to /jobs/detail/{id}.
- Listings are filterable by skills, seniority, work mode (remote/hybrid/onsite),
  employment type (full_time, part_time, contract, freelance, internship),
  language and location.
- Content is available in 5 languages via the `?lang=` query parameter
  (it default, en, es, fr, de).

## Not indexable / out of scope

- /admin, /auth, /wizard, /profile, /favorites (private or app-only areas).
